# A note on this month's Patch Tuesday
[MSRC Updates](https://www.microsoft.com/msrc/blog/category?cat=MSRC-Updates "MSRC Updates")
/ By Tom Gallagher / May 12, 2026
Each Patch Tuesday looks a little different. Some months are quieter, others are larger. This month's release sits on the larger side of a hotpatch month, and we expect releases to continue trending larger for some time.

...

...

We are still early in this work, at Microsoft and across the industry, and what we are seeing so far tracks with what we expected. Advanced AI models are surfacing additional issues in code we have already studied closely, mostly within well-understood vulnerability categories.

...

Out-of-band releases remain reserved for cases where they are warranted, but as discovery continues to scale, customers should be prepared for more frequent cases where out-of-band updates require immediate attention.

...

The pace at which they need to be applied is changing, and the organizations that adjust with it will be the ones best positioned for what comes next.

# Microsoft Patch Tuesday Security Recap: June 2026 Edition
## Threat Summary
On June 9, 2026, Microsoft released its regular Patch Tuesday security update, fixing 206 vulnerabilities (with 39 rated Critical) affecting a broad spectrum of Microsoft products including Windows kernel, Hyper-V, Remote Desktop Client, Kerberos, DHCP, BitLocker, HTTP.sys, Exchange Server, and Office.

...

## **Recommendations**
### **IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:**
* Apply all June 2026 security patches immediately, namely zero-days mentioned and other immediate patching guidance actions (see below).

...

### **PATCHING GUIDANCE:**
* Hyper-V critical out-of-bounds read vulnerabilities pertaining to CVE-2026-47652, CVE-2026-45641 and CVE-2026-45607. Apply these patches immediately on virtualized infrastructure and cloud hosts.
